data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'rheo', meaning 'to flow'. In Greek mythology, Ruthe was an alternative name for Rhodos, the goddess of love and compassion. In the Bible, Ruthe was a Moabite woman who demonstrated great loyalty and compassion towards Naomi and her family. The name Ruthe carries the meaning “Comfort, friend” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ruthe usually hope their child will grow to embody comfort, friend and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of comfort and friendship, rooted in the love and compassion shown by the biblical character Ruthe.
data.etymology: Ruthe belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Comfort, friend.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ruthe total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
